name: JP7
tagline: High-Speed Digital Textile and Paper Printer

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial textile printing technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure superior color accuracy, and support diverse fabric applications.

rows.label: Ink Colors
rows.value: 8 (C + M + Y + K + O + R + B + G)

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to support multiple ink technologies, offering flexibility for various fabric types while maintaining exceptional print quality and durability.

inkTypes.name: Reactive
inkTypes.fabrics: Cotton · Linen · Viscose · Natural Cellulose Fibres

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Dual Media Compatibility
items.desc: Prints on both textile and paper using the same system, giving businesses the flexibility to serve fabric and transfer paper production from a single machine.

items.title: Variable Drop Size Technology
items.desc: Printheads with 4 to 72 picolitre variable drop range deliver smooth gradients, fine detail, and rich solid areas with consistent quality across all design complexities.

items.title: Adhesive-Coated Belt Stability
items.desc: Adhesive belt securely holds all media types in place, including elastic and stretch fabrics, ensuring accurate registration and defect-free output throughout the print run.

items.title: Auto Cleaning System
items.desc: Automated wiper and capping assembly handles printhead maintenance between jobs, enabling immediate restart after inactivity without manual intervention or warm-up delays.

items.title: Uninterrupted Ink Supply System
items.desc: Refillable ink tanks with inline filtration allow live refilling during production without stopping the machine, eliminating downtime on high-coverage or long-run jobs.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Dual laser-beam sensors continuously scan for media unevenness ahead of the carriage, automatically preventing printhead contact with raised fabric surfaces or obstructions.

items.title: Wi-Fi Remote Control and Embedded Web Server
items.desc: Wireless monitoring and job cost reporting are accessible directly from the machine interface, allowing operators to track production status and costs without being at the console.

items.title: ACIMIT Green Label Certified
items.desc: Certified for sustainable innovation in energy, water, and chemical resource management, making the JP7 a compliant choice for manufacturers with sustainability targets.

items.title: High-Capacity Ink Tanks
items.desc: Integrated bulk ink tanks with an efficient refilling process, supporting long, uninterrupted production runs.

items.title: Open Architecture
items.desc: Open ink system and open software environment for greater flexibility in production workflows.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Reactive and disperse printing on a wide range of woven and knit fabrics for fashion garment manufacturers producing sarees, dress materials, kurtis, and casualwear.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Printing
fabrics.desc: High-quality disperse printing on polyester stretch and performance fabrics for sportswear brands, gym wear manufacturers, and activewear exporters.

fabrics.title: Transfer Paper Printing
fabrics.desc: Dual media compatibility makes the JP7 equally suited to sublimation transfer paper printing for manufacturers who service both direct fabric and transfer paper workflows.

fabrics.title: Home Textile and Soft Furnishing Production
fabrics.desc: Reactive and pigment printing on cotton and blended fabrics for bedding, cushion covers, curtains, and decorative home textile products.

fabrics.title: Accessories and Small-Format Textile Goods
fabrics.desc: Precise output and stable media handling make the JP7 well suited to scarves, stoles, bags, and other narrow-format or shorter-run accessory textile applications.

fabrics.title: Sustainable and Export-Focused Operations
fabrics.desc: ACIMIT Green Label certification supports manufacturers serving European and international buyers with documented sustainability and resource efficiency requirements.

productionCapacity.description: Choose the ideal speed and resolution combination to optimize production output and print performance.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium international components that deliver superior accuracy, durability, and consistent production efficiency.

largeCard.title: Industrial Variable Drop Printheads
largeCard.desc: 16× robust heads with 4 to 72 pl variable drop size for high-speed scanning output at up to 340 m/hr in 2x CMYK configuration

smallCards.title: Adhesive Belt Conveying System
smallCards.desc: Adhesive-coated belt transport for stable, accurate media handling across fabric and paper substrates including elastic materials

smallCards.title: Wi-Fi and Embedded Web Server Module
smallCards.desc: Wireless remote control and integrated web server for real-time production monitoring and cost reporting from any connected device

smallCards.title: Inline Ink Filtration System
smallCards.desc: Continuous ink filtration with live-refill capability ensuring clean, uninterrupted ink delivery without production stops

smallCards.title: Bearings — SKF (Sweden)
smallCards.desc: High-precision, low-friction bearings engineered for extended mechanical life across sustained production cycles

smallCards.title: Wiring — Lapp (Germany)
smallCards.desc: Industrial-grade control panel wiring throughout the complete machine system

smallCards.title: Control Systems — Omron (Japan)
smallCards.desc: Industrial-grade automation and control components managing all machine functions

smallCards.title: RIP Software — neoStampa Professional Edition
smallCards.desc: Industry-standard RIP with ICC colour management, Pantone library, job queuing, and complete production workflow tools

smallCards.title: ACIMIT Green Label Certification
smallCards.desc: Independently certified for sustainable energy, water, and chemical resource management in industrial textile printing

smallCards.title: Open Ink System
smallCards.desc: Open architecture supporting flexible ink choice across production workflows

smallCards.title: Open Software Environment
smallCards.desc: Flexible workflow integration with third-party RIP and production tools
